settings.title: System config
settings.subtitle: Branding and look. Changes apply to everyone using the shop.
settings.shopNameHint: Shown on the sign-in screen and in the browser tab.
settings.themeHint: Tints the background across the whole app. Content panels stay white so forms and tables remain easy to read.
settings.logoHint: Shown on the sign-in screen, in the top bar, and as the browser tab icon. PNG or SVG with a transparent background works best. Max 2 MB.
settings.refreshTabs: Saved. Refresh other tabs to see the new look.
settings.discountFloorHint: Sets the shop-wide minimum profit margin. Ad-hoc discounts can never drop a sale below this floor unless an owner explicitly overrides. Products that set their own margin floor on the product page override this default.
settings.discountFloorExample: Example: 30% means a product that cost 500 RWF can be discounted down to a sell price of 650 RWF (cost + 30%) but no lower.

products.title: Products
products.emptyFiltered: Nothing matches. Try clearing the filters, or tap + New product.

form.imageHint: Upload a photo for this category. Shown on the POS tile instead of the icon. PNG, JPG, WebP, or SVG. Max 2 MB.

categories.newSubtitle: A grouping for the /sell grid. The icon is shown on the POS tile.

channels.newSubtitle: A sales channel (e.g. retail, wholesale, delivery, online).
channels.cannotDeactivateNote: Cannot deactivate while there are recent sales.
channels.deactivateBody: This sets the channel to inactive. It is hidden from active filters and excluded from new sales, but all history (audit log, prior sales) is preserved. You can reactivate it later from the edit page.
channels.deactivateCustomersWarn: {count, plural, =1 {# customer still has} other {# customers still have}} this as their primary channel. They are not deleted; you can reassign them later.
channels.cannotDeactivateReason: {count, plural, =1 {# sale} other {# sales}} on this channel in the last 30 days. Wait until activity dies down, or pick a different channel for new sales first.

purchases.subtitle: Stock you bought from suppliers. Draft = not yet received, Received = in stock.

form.noLines: No lines yet. Add a product below.
form.receivedNote: Received — stock is in the ledger.
form.confirmCancelReceived: This will reverse the stock that was received. Continue?

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.subtitle: How the shop is performing. Pick a period and read the numbers at a glance.
analytics.dashboardSubtitle: Net profit, top sellers, stock health
analytics.customDatesHint: Pick "Custom range" and the dates above to view a specific window. Otherwise the preset wins.
analytics.salesByDayHint: Tap the highest and lowest bars to spot patterns.
analytics.topProductsHint: Most units moved in this period.
analytics.lowStockCount: {count, plural, =0 {No products running low} =1 {# product running low} other {# products running low}}
analytics.outOfStockCount: {count, plural, =0 {Everything in stock} =1 {# product out of stock} other {# products out of stock}}
analytics.noData: Nothing here yet for this period.
analytics.currentCostNote: Cost of stock sold uses the cost recorded at the moment of each sale. Sales made before cost-snapshotting (Jul 2026) use current cost as an approximation.
analytics.noSalesYet: No sales in this period yet
analytics.noSalesHint: Once a few sales come in, the trend will appear here.
analytics.profitByProductHint: What each product actually earned after cost, sorted by profit. Green ≥15% margin, amber 5–15%, red below 5%.

restock.title: Restock plan
restock.subtitle: Suggested orders from your real sales speed: average over the last {burnDays} days, aiming for {coverDays} days of cover. Rounded up to whole cartons.
restock.editHint: Suggestions are pre-filled — adjust cartons or cost to match your supplier, totals update live.
restock.scopeNote: Sales rate ignores products with no sales in the window — dormant items never trigger an order. Costs use the current purchase price.
restock.draftErrorNoLines: Nothing to order — set cartons on at least one product first.
restock.draftErrorNoSupplier: Pick the supplier this order goes to.
restock.draftHint: Turns the sheet above into a draft purchase. You'll review it on the purchase page and mark it received when the stock arrives — that's when stock and costs are written.

treasury.title: Money available
treasury.subtitle: Cash in the drawer plus MoMo and bank balances — what you can spend on restock.
treasury.transferReferencePlaceholder: MoMo agent receipt no., bank slip…
treasury.transferHint: Records physical cash leaving the drawer for MoMo or the bank. The till close will expect less cash, so the deposit doesn't show up as a shortage.
treasury.checkpointHint: Check your real MoMo or bank statement and type the balance right now. From that moment the system tracks it forward automatically (sales in, expenses out, cash deposits in). Re-set it whenever you reconcile.

salesHistory.title: Sales history
salesHistory.subtitle: Every sale with its profit. Tap a sale to see the line-by-line breakdown.
salesHistory.empty: No sales match these filters yet.
salesHistory.scopeNote: Shows the most recent 100 sales for the filters. Profit uses the cost recorded at the moment of each sale.
salesHistory.couponUsed: Coupon {code} was used on this sale
salesHistory.approximateCostNote: * Cost for this line is approximate — the sale predates cost snapshotting, so today's cost was used.

stockTake.title: Stock take
stockTake.subtitle: Count what's on the shelves and write a variance for anything that doesn't match. Adjustments land in the ledger with reason "Stock-take variance".
stockTake.empty: No active products to count yet.
stockTake.notePlaceholder: e.g. Monthly stock-take, Sunday close, breakage from yesterday…
stockTake.noteHint: Explain why you counted today. Stays on every variance ledger row so future you knows.
stockTake.errorAllRequired: Count every product before saving. Type 0 in cartons or loose for anything that's truly empty.
stockTake.errorNoteRequired: Add a short note explaining the stock-take.
stockTake.scopeNote: Adjustments are written to the stock ledger with reason "Stock-take variance" and your user id.
stockTake.historyEmpty: No stock-takes recorded yet. Your first count will appear here.
stockTake.historyLineCount: {count, plural, =1 {# product counted} other {# products counted}}

myDay.stockSubtitle: What you might run out of today.
myDay.stockOutCount: {count, plural, =1 {# out of stock} other {# out of stock}}
myDay.stockLowCount: {count, plural, =1 {# running low} other {# running low}}

audit.title: Activity log
audit.subtitle: Sign-ins, big cash variances, and other things worth a glance. Last 30 days.
audit.empty: Nothing logged in the last 30 days.

register.title: Purchase & sales register
register.subtitle: Every purchase and sale line in the period, with totals — made for the accountant. Download any table as CSV for Excel.
register.summaryHint: Bought vs sold per product, with profit.
register.salesHint: {count, plural, =0 {No sale lines} =1 {# sale line} other {# sale lines}} in the period, one row per product per sale.
register.purchasesHint: {count, plural, =0 {No purchase lines} =1 {# purchase line} other {# purchase lines}} — received purchases only.
register.scopeNote: Sales cost uses the cost recorded at the moment of each sale. Purchases include received orders only — drafts and cancelled orders are excluded.

reports.title: Daily summary
reports.subtitle: Sales, expenses, top sellers — by day.
reports.discounts: {amount} in discounts on {count, plural, =1 {# line} other {# lines}}
reports.emptySessions: No cash sessions touched this day.

coupons.title: Coupons
coupons.subtitle: Issue one-time-use discount codes. Share the code (WhatsApp, written slip); the cashier types it at checkout.
coupons.emptyHint: Create a coupon to give a customer a one-time discount.
coupons.relAgo: {count, plural, =1 {# day ago} other {# days ago}}
coupons.confirmRevoke: Revoke this coupon? The code will stop working.

form.newSubtitle: Set the discount, share the code with the customer, the cashier types it at checkout.
form.createdShare: Share this code with the customer. Expires {when}.
form.perUnitHint: Tick this if the discount should come off each item in the matched line — e.g. "700 RWF off every bottle" on a 100-bottle order is 70,000 RWF total. Otherwise the discount is taken once across the whole line.
form.productHint: Cart-wide discounts apply to the whole sale; product-locked coupons only work on the chosen item.
form.marginLine: Cost {cost} / unit · Sells for {price} · After discount {final}
form.belowCostWarn: Heads up — final price is below cost. The cashier won't be able to redeem this unless you tick "Allow floor override" below.
form.codeHint: Auto-generated codes are 6 chars and exclude lookalike letters (0/O/I/1). Custom codes must be 4–20 letters or digits.
form.notePlaceholder: Who is this for? (Wholesale buyer Jean-Paul …)
form.floorOverrideHint: Lets this coupon redeem even if it breaches the minimum margin (audit-logged). Use for clearance or strategic loss-leaders.
